title: Murders at Karlov Manor Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who gathers suspects and declares the killer is among them; he can conjure ethereal models of crime scenes.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: A manor whose parties are strictly invitation only.

entities.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
entities.description: A streetwise lookout who trades information for a price.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A known killer who answers questions evasively.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A speaker advising leaving many false trails when one's own can't be erased.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Regal guild leader tangled in the heart of Vitu-Ghazi, guarding secrets; Kaya senses something off about her.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Trostani and races with Kellan to prevent a guild war.

entities.name: Thare
entities.description: Member of the Foundway Associates who orders surveillance of the crime scene.

entities.name: Foundway Associates
entities.description: A group of investigators.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A spirit of justice who postpones retirement.

entities.name: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole
entities.description: A mole whose claws tear at the foundations of civilization.

entities.name: Dr. A
aliases: Dr. A of the Foundway Associates
entities.description: Foundway Associates investigator analyzing nightbloom evidence.

entities.name: Avult
entities.description: Foundway Associates investigator reporting suspect sightings.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: A market with Yescu Street and Oak Street entrances.

entities.name: Lobar Alley
entities.description: An alley where a suspect was spotted.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A guild that tidies up scenes and can read the dead.

entities.name: Agency
entities.description: An organization with custodians who handle devices.

entities.name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
entities.description: A performer who shouts the truth from the stage.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild whose verity circles are used for questioning.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Patron of Chaos who applauds performances.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane many have tried and failed to subjugate.

entities.name: Museum of Ravnican History
entities.description: A museum whose writings are quoted.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: A place in whose heart Trostani is tangled.

entities.name: Taboro
entities.description: Foundway Associates member commenting on Golgari reading the dead.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Leader who musters the Boros Legion.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild army mustered by Aurelia.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Races with Kaya to stave off a guild war.

events.summary: Proft assembles the suspects and declares the killer is in the room.
events.quote: our killer is here with us, in this very room.

events.summary: Proft conjures a model of the ransacked workshop, sensing he missed something.
events.quote: At Proft's command, an ethereal model of the ransacked workshop sprang into being, every detail perfectly recreated.

events.summary: Kaya has an audience with Trostani and senses something off.
events.quote: Kaya couldn't shake the sense that there was something off

events.summary: Agency custodians are caught by a device explosion.
events.quote: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive

events.summary: Guests at the manor are questioned in an Azorius verity circle.
events.quote: No guest was permitted to leave before being questioned in an Azorius verity circle.

events.summary: Aurelia musters the Boros Legion while Kaya and Kellan race to prevent a guild war.
events.quote: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock
